caption: The drawing is a monochrome line illustration depicting an ornamental cast iron light bracket mounted on what appears to be the exterior wall of a building. The bracket features decorative scrollwork and supports a large, clear glass lamp with a flared rim at the top. The lamp is secured to the bracket by a horizontal metal band. Behind the bracket and lamp, a portion of an urban streetscape is visible, including building facades with architectural detailing, windows, and signage, all rendered in line work. Measurements are indicated on the left and bottom sides of the bracket as 15 inches in height and 13 inches in length from the wall. Below the bracket, the text “ORNAMENTAL CAST IRON LIGHT BRACKET” is neatly printed. The overall composition uses thin, precise black lines on a beige background, with cross-hatching and shading to provide depth and texture.
title: Cast Iron Lamp Bracket
